thread:
mira-sales: Quick ask — SynergyHealth (EU payer) wants a single POC evidence packet. They listed: SOC 2 Type II excerpts, ISO 27001 cert, EU network diagram, signed pen-test attestation (prefers signed letter), and a short note on Dedicated vs Private cost/timeline. POC kickoff planned Jun 24. Can someone own? @frank-security? :eyes:

ash-ae: Clarifying q: full SOC2 or excerpts/control matrix? Also check if they need vendor contact redaction. I'll ping PO.

frank-security: I can own the artifact pull and CVE->remediation note. Plan: SOC2 Type II excerpt (control matrix + redacted system desc), ISO cert copy, and updated EU network diagram. For signed attestation we have a standard template; legal must sign. ETA ~2 business days once scope + recipient confirmed.

artifact-bot: Proofpack workspace created: s3://proofpacks/synergy/4123456789/ Presign (48h): curl -X PUT "https://uploads.redwood/proofpacks/4123456789?sig=pp_sig" -F file=@evidence.zip :lock:

jo-infra: We can provision 3 static IPs for external scans within 24h after owner assigned. Dedicated for POC adds approx +$7k/mo; Private needs ~10 business days and a one-time onboarding fee (~$12k). If they want KMS/HSM separation note, we can include a short summary.

rebecca-legal: We can provide a signed pen-test attestation on letterhead. Need recipient name and exact requested wording (e.g., "no critical findings as of [scan date]"). NDA check required. Typical turnaround: draft 1 business day, sign next.

mira-sales: Target delivery of bundle by Jun 18 so procurement has time before Jun 24. Ash please confirm Type II vs Type I + redaction preference with PO today. Frank please own pull and upload to the proofpack. Jo reserve IPs and add to manifest. Rebecca I'll DM recipient details if they want signed letter.

ash-ae: Pinged PO. They prefer Type II excerpts and redaction is fine. Confirmed they want the signed attestation wording: "no critical or high findings as of scan date". Will share recipient email by EOD. :thumbsup:

frank-security: Acknowledged. Will start pulling artifacts once recipient email posted. Will draft attestation and tag legal for signature.

mira-sales: Thanks all — post blockers here. :rocket:
